items.comment: PK=STREAM#<streamId>#<yyyyMMddHHmm> SK=<commentId uuidv7> | authorId, authorName, text, removed, expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: persist: BatchWriteItem (25/request) from the live.events consumer
replay a VOD minute: Query PK=STREAM#s#<minute> (SK = uuidv7 → time-ordered)
moderation removal: UpdateItem SET removed = true
_design.why: 5k comments/s on ONE stream would be a single hot partition (DynamoDB partitions cap ~1k WCU); a minute bucket spreads writes over a new partition every minute and keeps each partition small; uuidv7 sort keys keep the order
